title: 1999 AHSME Problem 8
statement: At the end of \(1994\) Walter was half as old as his grandmother. The sum of the years in which they were born is \(3838.\) How old will Walter be at the end of \(1999?\)

solutions.text:
Let Walter be \(w\) years old at the end of \(1994,\) so his grandmother is \(2w.\) Their birth years are \(1994 - w\) and \(1994 - 2w,\) and \[ \begin{aligned} &(1994 - w) \\ &\quad {}+ (1994 - 2w) = 3838. \end{aligned} \] This gives \(3988 - 3w = 3838,\) so \(w = 50.\)

At the end of \(1999,\) Walter will be \(50 + 5 = 55.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
